# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

This project is maintained by one person. Everyone taking part —
reporting a bug, asking a question, suggesting a change — is expected to
be respectful and constructive.

Not acceptable:

- Personal attacks, insults, or derogatory comments
- Harassment of any kind, public or private
- Publishing others' private information without permission
- Sustained disruption of discussions

## Scope

Applies to issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other space where
someone is representing this project.

## Reporting

Report unacceptable behaviour to **jaydevbaloliya@gmail.com**. Reports
are handled privately.

The maintainer may edit, lock, or delete contributions that break these
standards, and may block accounts that repeat the behaviour.
